caption: Javelin with a damaged tip is thrown; it wobbles in flight and lands off-target.
conditions: first frame, caption, existing requirements; no future target
physical_dependency_analysis:
OBSERVED: Javelin with intact tip, no wobble, landing on blue line (target). Unknown: Damage state, flight dynamics, landing point.

INTERACTION: Tip damage → aerodynamic imbalance → wobbling → altered trajectory → off-target landing.

PERSISTENCE: Damage sustains imbalance; wobble propagates through flight; trajectory deviation persists until impact.

INTERVENTION: If tip intact → no wobble → trajectory stable → lands on target. If no damage → no deviation → target hit.
